app:
If your Army Faction is **WORLD EATERS**, at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll. To do so, roll eight D6. You can then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne (see below). Each Blessing of Khorne specifies the dice results it requires (where a number is specified, a double or triple of that value or higher is required). You can only activate each Blessing of Khorne once per battle round. Any unused dice from the Blessings of Khorne roll are then discarded. Once activated, each Blessing of Khorne applies to all units from your army with this ability until the end of the battle round.
*Example: Ash makes a Blessings of Khorne roll, getting the following: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 6.*
*First they use the two 6s to activate Warp Blades (which requires a double 5+), leaving the following dice: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4.*
*They then use the two 2s to activate Unbridled Bloodlust.*
*Now that two Blessings of Khorne have been activated, no more can be activated and the remaining dice are discarded.*

reason: Typo fixed: Wahapedia prints the example dice as "1,2, 2, 2, 3, 4" (missing space); the app writes "1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4" like the other dice lists of the same example. No pack prints this army rule.

app: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, if the target is more than 18" away from the bearer, an unmodified successful **Hit roll** of 4+ scores a Critical Hit.
source: …matches up to "his weapon, if the target is more than 1" then source has: "2" from the bearer, an unmodified successful hit roll of 4+ scores a critical hit. graviton pulsar [anti-vehicle 2+, bla" | sentences not found: ["each time an attack is made with this weapon, if the target is more than 18\" away from the bearer, an unmodified successful hit roll of 4+ scores a critical hit."]
reason: [CONVERSION] is a weapon ability GW's datasheets define per weapon, each with its own range (the Faction Pack's Armiger Moirax conversion beam cannon: "more than 12""; its Knight Castellan/Valiant profile: "more than 24""). The app's lists have one such weapon, the Knight Defender's conversion beam obliterator, so the glossary entry is that datasheet's wording (RULE_SRC names it). GW's Faction Pack does not reprint the Knight Defender datasheet; the Wahapedia Knight Defender datasheet (the codex) is the only source of these words, which texts.js does not search for glossary entries.
evidence: verify/.cache/waha/ds/imperial-knights_Knight-Defender.html, under the weapons: "Conversion: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, if the target is more than 18" away from the bearer, an unmodified successful Hit roll of 4+ scores a Critical Hit."; GW Faction Pack Imperial Knights lines 369 and 785 (other weapons' Conversion, 24" and 12").
